postList.title: Posts
postList.selectAllHint: Loads every post matching the applied filters, up to {limit}. Narrow the filters if there are more.
postList.selectionHelp: Your selection survives paging and sorting, and is cleared when filters change. Select up to {selection} posts; each batch holds up to {batch} and is previewed and confirmed separately.
postList.selectionOverLimit: Too many results to select them all. Narrow the filters first.
postList.tableRegion: Post list, scrolls horizontally on wide screens
postList.recentHint: The last 10 actions that were started. Results stay available after a refresh.
postList.loginLink: sign in to the owner account
postList.selectionLimit: You can select up to {limit} posts. Clear some first.
postList.pageSelectionLimit: You can select up to {limit} posts, so this page wasn't added.
postList.filterChanged: The filtered results changed. Refresh the list and select all again.
postList.filterReordered: The filtered results were reordered. Refresh the list and select all again.
postList.selectAllFailed: Couldn't load all filtered results. Your previous selection is kept; please try again.
postList.loadFailed: Couldn't load posts. Check that you're signed in and try again.
postList.restoreConfirm: Restore “{title}” as a draft? It will stay unpublished.
postList.archiveConfirm: Archive “{title}”? The post and its comments are kept, and you can restore it as a draft.
postList.restoreFailed: Couldn't restore. Please try again later.
postList.archiveFailed: Couldn't archive. Please try again later.

postSave.inTrash: This post is in the trash. Restore it as a draft from the post list first.
postSave.optionsFailed: Couldn't load series and tag options. You can still type them in.
postSave.loadFailed: Couldn't load the post. Check that you're signed in and try again.
postSave.saveFailed: Couldn't save. Your unsaved changes are still on this page.
postSave.serverReadFailed: {message}. Couldn't read the server version either; try saving again later. Your local edits are kept.
postSave.keptLocal: Your edits are kept. Merge any server changes you need, then save again; the server's version remains in the revision history.
postSave.recoveryServerFailed: Couldn't read the latest server version, so nothing was restored. The local copy is kept; try again once you're back online.
postSave.recoveryApplied: The recovery copy is loaded into the editor but not saved to the server yet. Review it, then save manually.
postSave.discardRecoveryConfirm: Remove this local recovery copy? The server content won't change, and the copy can't be recovered once removed.
postSave.historyLoaded: The past revision is loaded but not saved to the server yet. Review and merge it, then save manually.
postSave.restoreRevisionConfirm: Restoring creates a new server draft and unpublishes the post if it's currently public. Unsaved edits are kept as a local copy first. Restore this revision?
postSave.revisionRestored: Revision restored as a new server draft. Engagement counts are kept.
postSave.revisionRestoreFailed: Couldn't restore the revision. Your current edits are kept.
postSave.leaveConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?

postWorkspace.local: Local recovery copy: {state}. Local copies are never published.
postWorkspace.autoSaveToggle: Auto-save the server draft after 15 seconds of inactivity
postWorkspace.nonDraftPublished: This post is published, so auto-save only writes a local copy. Save to the server manually.
postWorkspace.nonDraftArchived: This post is archived, so auto-save only writes a local copy. Save to the server manually.
postWorkspace.autoSavePaused: Server auto-save is paused. Compare the recovered content or conflict, then save manually.
postWorkspace.dirty: You have changes that aren't saved to the server.
postWorkspace.recoveriesHint: These may come from an earlier refresh, a lost connection or another editor tab. Compare them before deciding whether to load one.
postWorkspace.continueWithout: Skip for now and keep editing
postWorkspace.compareDescription: Loading only changes the editor and doesn't write to the server. Review and merge, then save manually.
postWorkspace.compareKeepLocal: Load the local copy and keep editing
postWorkspace.preserved: Your earlier input was kept as a local copy.
postWorkspace.recoverPreserved: Restore earlier input and keep editing

postEditor.title: Title
postEditor.readingStats: Length: {total} ({chinese} Chinese characters, {words} English words and numbers) · Estimated reading time about {minutes} min
postEditor.readingTooltip: Fill in the reading time from the current length. You can still edit it afterwards.
postEditor.readingHint: Chinese is counted by character, English and numbers by word; code blocks and images are excluded. Estimates assume about 350 Chinese characters or 220 English words per minute. The reading time is only filled in when you click the button, and you can still edit it.
postEditor.readingApplied: Set to {minutes} min. You can still edit it.
postEditor.coverPlaceholder: https:// or a site image path
postEditor.coverFailed: Couldn't load the cover preview. Check the URL or try again later.
postEditor.slugPlaceholder: e.g. vue-reactivity; leave empty to use the numeric URL
postEditor.slugHint: Start with a lowercase letter and use only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Old URLs keep pointing here after a change.
postEditor.seoTitlePlaceholder: Leave empty to use the post title
postEditor.seoDescriptionPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the summary or an excerpt
postEditor.noindex: Hide from search engines (the post stays public)
postEditor.bodyHint: Paste or drop JPEG, PNG or WebP images (up to 8 MB each) to upload them to the media library and insert them into the body.
postEditor.publishUpdate: Confirming will update the published post.
postEditor.publishNew: Once confirmed, the post goes public and visitors can read and interact with it.
postEditor.indexingOff: Not indexed, but still publicly accessible
postEditor.indexingOn: Indexed and included in the sitemap
postEditor.noCover: No cover set; the post will be shown without one.
postEditor.coverCheckFailed: The cover preview failed. Make sure the URL is correct before publishing.
postEditor.altDescription: These images have no alt text, so screen reader users may not understand them. Go back to add it, or publish anyway.
postEditor.altCover: The cover has no alt text. Fill in “Cover alt text”.
postEditor.altImage: Image {image} in the body (line {line}) has no alt text.
postEditor.slugCheckHint: The URL is checked for uniqueness again on save; a failed save won't clear your input.

postBatch.title: Confirm bulk action
postBatch.queue: {total} posts selected, processed in {count} batches of up to {limit}. This is batch {index}. Each batch must be previewed and confirmed separately; later batches never run automatically.
postBatch.closeHint: Closing skips the remaining batches. Submitted batches can still be checked under “Recent bulk actions”.
postBatch.summary: Action: {action}. {selected} posts explicitly selected, {allowed} can be processed.

effect.delete: Permanently deletes the posts with their comments, revisions, past URLs and engagement records; they can't be restored from the trash. Media files are kept. The list below shows how many referencing records will be deleted.
effect.trash: The posts are removed from public view. Body, comments, revisions and URLs are kept, and restored posts become drafts.
effect.archive: The posts are removed from public view and archived. Content and comments are kept.
effect.draft: The posts become unpublished drafts. Existing comments, revisions and URLs are kept.

postBatch.ticketHint: The preview is valid for 5 minutes. Versions and impact are checked again on execution, and changed items are skipped. Executed actions can be reopened under “Recent bulk actions” below the post list.
postBatch.expired: This ticket has expired and can't be executed. Check the result first, review the remaining posts, then close this panel and select and preview again.
postBatch.unfinished: The current batch isn't confirmed as finished. Check its result or continue with the same ticket before starting another bulk action.
postBatch.previewFailed: Couldn't preview this batch, so nothing was run. You can retry it; finished batches won't be submitted again.
postBatch.selectionLimit: You can select up to {limit} posts at once. Narrow the selection and try again.
postBatch.refreshFailed: The bulk result arrived, but the post list couldn't be refreshed. Refresh the list to verify.
postBatch.recordFailed: Couldn't load this action record. Close and try again.
postBatch.executeFailed: The full result didn't arrive. Check the result or continue with the same ticket; processed items won't be changed twice.
postBatch.queryFailed: Couldn't check the result. The ticket is kept, so you can retry.

postConflict.diffSummary: View body changes: {removed} lines removed, {added} lines added
postConflict.diffHint: From {from} to {to}. The changed region is shown in full, with up to three lines of context on each side.
postConflict.defaultDescription: Your input is still here. Compare both versions, then load the server version or keep your input and keep merging.
postConflict.defaultUseServer: Load the server version and set aside your input
postConflict.defaultKeepLocal: Keep your input and merge onto the latest version

postHistory.compareDescription: Load it into the editor to merge, or explicitly restore it as a new server draft. Restoring a revision doesn't roll back engagement counts.
postHistory.compareLoad: Load this revision and keep editing
postHistory.restore: Restore revision {revision} as a server draft
postHistory.loadFailed: Couldn't load revision history. Please try again.
postHistory.inspectFailed: Couldn't load this revision. Please try again.

postOutline.label: Sections ({count})
postOutline.hint: The cursor moves to the start of the heading line.
postOutline.empty: Add Markdown headings to jump between sections here.

postPreview.title: Share draft preview
postPreview.description: Links are valid for 7 days, and anyone with the link can view it without signing in. Old links keep working until they expire and always show the latest saved content.
postPreview.unavailableStates: Published, archived or trashed posts can't be previewed.
postPreview.notSaved: Save the draft first, then create a preview link.
postPreview.notDraft: Only drafts that aren't deleted can have preview links. Save it as a draft first.
postPreview.dirty: You have unsaved changes. The preview only shows what's saved on the server, and creating a link doesn't save your input.
postPreview.generateTooltip: Creates a 7-day preview link for the saved draft only; your current input isn't saved
postPreview.copyTooltip: Copy the full preview link. Share it only with people you trust.
postPreview.open: Open preview in a new tab
postPreview.expires: Valid until {time}. Creating a new link doesn't revoke earlier ones.
postPreview.generated: Preview link created and ready to share.
postPreview.generateFailed: Couldn't create the preview link. Check that you're signed in and try again.
postPreview.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. The link is still below; select and copy it manually.

postRecovery.invalid: {count} local copy is malformed; the raw data is kept and it was skipped. | {count} local copies are malformed; the raw data is kept and they were skipped.
postRecovery.readFailed: Couldn't read local copies. Check your browser's storage permissions.
postRecovery.writeFailed: Couldn't save a local copy. Your input is still on the page; don't close it. Retry or save to the server.
postRecovery.clearFailed: Saved to the server, but the old local copy couldn't be cleared. You can check it again later.
postRecovery.discardFailed: Couldn't remove the local copy. Please try again later.

imageUpload.unsupportedType: Only JPEG, PNG and WebP images are supported
imageUpload.tooLarge: Images must be 8 MB or smaller
imageUpload.placeholderRemoved: {name} was uploaded to the media library, but its placeholder was removed from the body, so it wasn't inserted
imageUpload.missingAlt: {count} image has no alt text. Add a description inside the square brackets. | {count} images have no alt text. Add descriptions inside the square brackets.
